sources.limitations: Central California Appellate Program's court and county directory identifies the firm for Madera public defense; its own contact page publishes the administrative mailbox. The firm's Madera, Amador and Calaveras offices are identified in its staff page. Shared firm administration, not a county-run or separate client intake mailbox; verify the county-specific contract and route. These contacts do not establish authority to investigate a medical grievance. Preserve designated intake routes; do not transmit confidential records through ordinary email. Deliverability not tested.
